verdict.rationale: The Gemini API documents first-party Gemini managed agents that users can delegate tasks to, for example through the official `gemini-api` CLI. The release notes list Managed Agents as a public preview, and the quickstart mentions agents and background execution. The evidence is only a few brief mentions, with no detail on how delegation works inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the managed-agent delegation workflow, an assistant built into the product UI, GA status beyond preview, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Your coding agent can use it to generate text and media, analyze files, and delegate tasks to [Gemini managed agents].
function calling, agents, and background execution
